allocation_proof.constructor_prune_explanation: Default csc_array uses same dtype arrays without casting copies. check_format(full_check=False) calls prune. _prune_array copies an index/data prefix only when its length is less than half the original. All six original arrays remain C-local referenced through both constructors; extra index+data copies together are less than 10*Q bytes. Use <=10*Q conservatively.
allocation_proof.linear_scratch_explanation: Adds conservative room for complex128 U diagonal and comparison (17*n), both int32 permutation sorts, int64 aranges and comparison masks (26*n total). Existing fixed 32 MiB workspace is preserved for scalar/object headers and bounded small-library scratch. typed_hash hashes a memoryview without full payload copy.

phase_split.one_CSR_slot_evidence: The initial _csr extraction and CSR-to-CSC conversion finish before splu. del arrays/indptr/indices/values/rhs occurs at line 122; del csc at 132. There is exactly one subsequent self._csr(A,np), at 151, for original operator/hash validation. Its implementation obtains one CSR triplet via A.getValuesCSR, np.asarray causes no dtype conversions, and typed_hash uses memoryviews. Reserve its whole triplet at complex128 values plus up to 8-byte indices/pointers. No second future CSC construction or factorization exists in the reviewed setUp path.
phase_split.ownership_nuance: The capture loop at lines 110-112 leaves local array referencing the final CSR values after the explicit del at 122. Do not describe all initial CSR data as released. That reference and all native factors, existing matrix buffers, cached/library memory and allocator-retained pages are charged by fresh actual VmSize/RSS; no subtraction or release assumption is made.
phase_split.post_export_requirements: Keep full existing finite L/U, nonzero U diagonal, triangular counts, permutations, operator/hash immutability, true original CSR residual, original field and port checks. No solve may bypass failed export admission or diagnostics. Export caches remain charged until lu destruction and actual subsequent snapshots.
phase_split.post_factor_gate_location: After sparse_probe.py line 133 and before line 135; perform no .L/.U access before the new gate.
phase_split.post_factor_guard: Use original resource.admit with Bpost and a fresh resource/address snapshot; require fresh VmSize+Bpost < unchanged effective_AS. Original tree RSS, zero-swap, host-available, ELF/safety and other admission rules remain mandatory.
phase_split.pre_factor_change: Defer only the two factor-export payload and finite-factor-mask terms. Preserve other original named reservations and all native-factor/whole-process guards. Earlier complete warm/preassembly accounting must remain phase-aware, not claim full solve admission from Bpre alone.

scalar_preconditions: Pin and verify reviewed runtime/source hashes; successful fresh square complex128 splu under the unchanged options; ordinary SciPy csc_array export constructor, no replacement or monkeypatch.
Before factorization require type(n) is int, n>80, and n*(n+1)<=2147483647. This avoids overflow of native factor counters and the 32-bit scalar sum under the reviewed triangular storage bound.
After successful factorization and before any access to .L or .U, read Q=int(lu.nnz), require type(Q) is int and 2*n<=Q<=n*(n+1), and reverify unchanged RLIMIT_AS.
Q is initial export allocation capacity, not native-memory bytes, not a workspace bound, and not necessarily final L.nnz+U.nnz. Require exported count sum<=Q after export; equality is not required.
